title: Maternal air pollution exposure and congenital heart defects in offspring: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
authors: Hu CY, Huang K, Fang Y, Yang XJ, Ding K, Jiang W, Hua XG, Huang DY, Jiang ZX, Zhang XJ.
quote: In the meta-analyses, high versus low carbon monoxide (CO) exposure was associated with an increased risk of tetralogy of Fallot [odds ratio (OR) = 1.21, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.04-1.41], yet particulate matter ≤ 5 μm (PM 2.5 ) exposure was marginally associated with it.
